observations: Original ON_Object copy ctor installs base vtable, zeroes header slots+8 and+0x10, calls CopyUserData exactly once.

Original ON_Viewport copy ctor inlines base initialization, calls CopyUserData once, installs viewport vtable and copies scalar/matrix/UUID/near data; it does not route through viewport assignment or purge a pre-populated list.
Original viewport assignment has a self guard, purges destination userdata before CopyUserData, then copies mapped numeric fields.
Constructor copies the opaque byte at+0x1b; assignment copies+0x18,+0x19,+0x1a but leaves+0x1b untouched. The current typed view model does not expose this extra byte.
limits: Byte+0x1b meaning is unresolved; later published6 field names are not proof of its original5 semantics. Preserve it as opaque state with distinct constructor/assignment rules.
This is static original-binary analysis only. No original runtime execution, saved-view corpus, complete native registry, whole-view implementation or history/PC parity claim.
A01 immutable current-value ownership does not execute native polymorphic copies; A02 runtime and P03 provenance now provide one supported concrete reader/copy path.
